outcome_summary: Fixed the `listInsights()` multi-store branch in `mcp-server/src/tools/knowledge.ts` to apply `limit` and `offset` globally after merging and deduplicating results from all stores, rather than forwarding them per-store. This closes the last known pagination correctness gap: a `limit=N` request now returns at most N results regardless of how many stores are configured. Four new integration tests cover the corrected behavior and codify the pre-existing correctness of `searchInsights()`.
project_summary: Fixes a pagination correctness bug in the listInsights() multi-store branch of the MCP server's knowledge tool, where limit and offset were forwarded per-store rather than applied globally after merging results across stores. With the fix, a limit=N request in multi-store mode returns at most N results regardless of how many stores are configured, closing the last known pagination gap deferred from the prior cross-device ledger sync project. Four new integration tests cover the corrected behavior and codify the pre-existing correctness of searchInsights().
